config.audio: saved MP3; no regeneration or candidate selection

allmusiccaps.tail: discard; pad only songs shorter than 10 seconds

per.selection: minimum PER across ASR repeats of the same audio; also report first-pass PER
per.aggregate: sum edits / sum reference phonemes; report macro separately

ASR_repeat_selection: PER, edits, absolute hypothesis/reference phoneme difference, repeat index
candidate_selection: first two seeds; PER, edits, absolute phoneme difference, candidate index
